label: Takealot Marketplace
terms_note: Takealot Marketplace seller (South African business, ZAR); API key self-generated in the Seller Portal; offers bind to Takealot catalogue products; sandbox / rate limits / returns not on the pages read.

discovery.auth: api_key (generated in the Seller Portal at seller.takealot.com/api/seller-api; `Authorization: Key <api key>`)

endpoints.purpose: create offer on a catalogue product

reference.limits: Not read. - Takealot seller agreement (ZA); fulfilment via Takealot DC / lead-time.
mcp_sdk: none official found in the pages opened

fields.name: authorization
fields.help: The complete Authorization header value for your Seller API key exactly as the Takealot Seller Portal shows it (Seller Portal > API, https://seller.takealot.com/api/seller-api — generate the key there; the public reference only says to 'attach an Authorization header' and defers the format to that page).

config_fields.name: merchant_warehouse_id
config_fields.help: Your leadtime merchant_warehouse_id (listed at https://seller.takealot.com/api/seller-api/offers); required by set_inventory.

adapter.terms: Takealot Seller API v2 (South Africa). Takealot fulfils from its own DCs or your leadtime stock; prices are whole rand.

me.note: No account endpoint; the probe returns the number of your offers ({count}) to verify the key.

update_listing.note: PATCH /v2/offers/offer/{identifier} {selling_price} changes the LIVE selling price. `listing_id` is Takealot's Offer ID, or your SKU/barcode prefixed as SKU<sku> / BARCODE<barcode>; `price` must be a positive whole number of rand (decimals are rejected). Stock is set_inventory; titles are catalogue data. validation_errors in raw.

set_inventory.note: PATCH /v2/offers/offer/SKU{sku} {leadtime_stock: [{merchant_warehouse_id, quantity}]} sets your LEADTIME (merchant-warehouse) stock for the offer with that SKU; stock already at Takealot DCs is not changed. Needs the merchant_warehouse_id config field.

end_listing.note: status_action Disable sets the offer to 'Disabled by Seller' (reversible with Re-enable). `listing_id` is the Offer ID or SKU<sku>.

not_offered.create_listing: POST /v2/offers/offer/{barcode} creates an offer on an existing Takealot catalogue product identified by its barcode, with whole-rand selling_price/rrp and leadtime data; the vocabulary has no barcode.
not_offered.list_orders: GET /v1/sales/orders requires both start_date AND end_date (swagger get_sales_orders); the vocabulary has only `since` and the runtime cannot derive an end date.
not_offered.mark_shipped: Takealot fulfils customer orders from its distribution centres (sellers ship leadtime stock to Takealot via purchase orders); the Seller API has no customer-shipment or tracking call.

evidence: host seller-api.takealot.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (GoDaddy.com, Inc.)
probe: 4/4 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
spec https://seller-api.takealot.com/api-docs/swagger.json: 4/4 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
